message_types.name: MeshAuditTrigger
message_types.description: On-demand command event triggering dynamic topological inspection and fleet health audit

properties.name: audit_level
properties.description: Inspection depth: STANDARD, DEEP, or SECURITY

properties.name: target_cluster
properties.description: Target hierarchical locagram path or cluster prefix (e.g. /galicia)

properties.name: check_compliance
properties.description: Flag instructing the auditor reactor to verify plugin and schema integrity

message_types.name: MeshTopologyInspection
message_types.description: Comprehensive fleet topology and edge runtime audit event constructed via Google CEL and celext

properties.name: auditor_node_id
properties.description: Node identifier that executed the audit transformation

properties.name: auditor_locagram
properties.description: Hierarchical geographic/logical locagram path of the executing node

properties.name: is_root_gateway
properties.description: True if the audit was computed on the root gateway; false on child edge nodes

properties.name: parent_gateway_id
properties.description: Immediate upstream parent node ID in mesh tree

properties.name: active_plugins
properties.description: List of active plugin identifiers assigned to this node

properties.name: runtime_producer
properties.description: Configured producer identifier loaded from binduConfig.json

properties.name: runtime_log_level
properties.description: Active logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)

properties.name: time_ntp_server
properties.description: Configured NTP synchronization server

properties.name: schema_marine_registered
properties.description: True if the RawMarineData contract schema is registered in message types

properties.name: marine_schema_badge
properties.description: Emoji badge introspected dynamically from the schema registry

properties.name: audit_summary
properties.description: Human-readable summary message formatted via CEL string interpolation

properties.name: health_score
properties.description: Calculated topological and runtime compliance score (0-100)
